purpose: Adversarial test vectors for future independent transition validators. These are expected outcomes, not evidence that tests have executed.

cases.name: Profile alias substituted after approval
cases.mutation: Replace target profile content digest after evaluation or approval while retaining display name and version label.
cases.reason: Evaluation and authority decisions apply only to the exact frozen content identity.

cases.name: Stale source frontier
cases.mutation: Advance or replace source state after the snapshot was frozen but before CutoverReady without re-freezing and requalifying.
cases.reason: A previously qualified transition cannot silently consume different starting state.

cases.name: Implicit one-to-one conversion
cases.mutation: Map equal numeric balances or matching tickers across different instrument profiles without an authorized conversion profile.
cases.reason: Numeric equality and display labels do not establish semantic equivalence or redemption.

cases.name: Unmapped outstanding liability
cases.mutation: Attempt CutoverReady while an in-scope debt, liability, entitlement, dispute, or contractual obligation has no primary disposition.
cases.reason: Unmapped claims cannot disappear at cutover.

cases.name: Unilateral debt novation
cases.mutation: Change debtor or beneficiary without required authority decision and counterparty acceptance.
cases.reason: A target profile does not independently grant authority to rewrite a contract.

cases.name: Discharge without external evidence
cases.mutation: Mark an external payment obligation discharged because an instruction was accepted or local credit was deleted while finality evidence is absent.
cases.reason: Instruction, booking, local deletion, settlement and legal discharge are distinct propositions.

cases.name: Duplicate effect replay
cases.mutation: Retry the same transition effect after acknowledgement using the same effect identity.
cases.reason: A retry observes the existing result or conflict and does not apply a second economic effect.

cases.name: Partial cutover hides uncertainty
cases.mutation: An external or target effect may have occurred but acknowledgement was lost; mark the attempt Aborted and restart under a new identity.
cases.reason: Post-effect uncertainty requires exact reconciliation, not a clean-abort assertion.

cases.name: Double-spend in dual operation
cases.mutation: The same source claim is spendable in both source and target during the pilot.
cases.reason: Mirrored display balances must not create two independently spendable claims.

cases.name: Resource overbooking
cases.mutation: Cut over two exclusive reservations for the same resource, quantity and time window beyond evidenced capacity.
cases.reason: A financial balance or authorized plan cannot create physical capacity.

cases.name: Rights floor inferred from balance
cases.mutation: Target policy removes an essential right automatically due to low balance, reputation, contribution score, employment or governance rank without required constitutional authority.
cases.reason: Economic status is not a universal rights credential.

cases.name: Verifier self-certifies candidate output
cases.mutation: Qualification accepts the model's own success flag without an independent oracle bound to exact frozen inputs and outputs.
cases.reason: Candidate output and authoritative evaluation are separate roles.

cases.name: Foreign recognition creates local issuance
cases.mutation: Recognize an external instrument and automatically mint SAP, TEND, MYCEL or target-native credit without target issuer policy.
cases.reason: Foreign evidence cannot silently create a liability of the target issuer.

cases.name: Correction overwrites history
cases.mutation: Replace or delete a source receipt after a reversal, chargeback, reorganization or dispute instead of appending correction lineage.
cases.reason: Original evidence and subsequent correction must remain reconstructable.

cases.name: Pending external settlement declared final
cases.mutation: A provider timeout, pending webhook, accepted message, or unconfirmed chain observation is promoted to final settlement.
cases.reason: Finality must be established by the exact qualified source/rail profile.

cases.name: Governance approval expires before execution
cases.mutation: Execute after the exact approval's validity interval or after a superseding/revocation event without requalification.
cases.reason: Historical approval does not necessarily authorize a present effect.

cases.name: Hidden haircut introduced in target mapping
cases.mutation: Reduce or expire claims through rounding, an undocumented conversion rule, or target balance cap without explicit policy and affected-party authorization.
cases.reason: Loss allocation must be declared, authorized and auditable.

cases.name: Unresolved identity or source provenance
cases.mutation: Import a claim based only on a human-readable label or unauthenticated external record whose issuer/source identity cannot be pinned.
cases.reason: The record may be retained without granting it target authority.

cases.name: Simulation currency crosses into live economy
cases.mutation: A simulated balance or predicted outcome is accepted as a live claim or physical reservation.
cases.reason: Simulation outputs do not establish real economic effects.

cases.name: Reconciliation omits residuals
cases.mutation: Publish Completed while unexplained account differences, unclassified resource changes, or mandatory unresolved effects remain.
cases.reason: Mandatory discrepancies block successful completion.

cases.name: Authority roles silently collapse
cases.mutation: One principal proposes, approves, executes and independently reconciles the transition while separation policy does not explicitly authorize and risk-qualify that combination.
cases.reason: Schema validity or signatures alone do not establish independent authority.

cases.name: Legacy source subsystem becomes insolvent
cases.mutation: A bridge imports new claims from a source subsystem after issuer failure or insolvency evidence without target profile's explicit admission, loss and counterparty policy.
cases.reason: Interoperability must not turn a distressed source claim into an unqualified target liability.

cases.name: External FX quote reused after expiry
cases.mutation: Use a stale or profile-mismatched FX observation to authorize target quantities at cutover.
cases.reason: The exact rate profile, validity and execution decision must be checked at the relevant stage.

cases.name: Exit or appeal path missing
cases.mutation: Adopt a profile that makes an affected participant's only route to dispute or exit contingent on a balance or credential controlled by the institution being challenged.
cases.reason: A nominal appeal or exit mechanism is not sufficient if the same authority can disable access to it.

claim_ceiling: The corpus enumerates expected adversarial outcomes only.
No case is claimed to have been executed by a validator or CI.
Passing this corpus would not establish economic optimality, legal enforceability, production readiness, or real-world effectiveness.
